_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Master Piece#000.src: Look in your content book! I wrote the locations of the legendary creatures.
Master Piece#000.dst: 看看你的內容書！我把那些傳說生物的位置都寫上去了。

Master Piece#001.src: This is...just a normal cow. This is supposed to be legendary?
Master Piece#001.dst: 這……就只是一頭普通的牛。這也算傳說？

Master Piece#002.src: ...Caissop seemed to be looking forward to this painting a lot...

Master Piece#003.src: ...well, if he's blind, maybe you can fudge the details to give him something better.
Master Piece#003.dst: ……話說回來，反正他看不見，也許你可以在細節上動點手腳，給他更好的東西。

Master Piece#006.src: That sounds like a villager to you.
Master Piece#006.dst: 在你聽來，那根本是在形容村民。

Master Piece#007.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully he'll buy it.
Master Piece#007.dst: 該回去找 Caissop 了。希望他會買帳。

Master Piece#008.src: This is just a normal sheep! Are none of these supposed creatures really legendary?
Master Piece#008.dst: 這就只是一頭普通的羊！這些所謂的生物有哪一隻是真的傳說嗎？

Master Piece#009.src: You'll need to lie about something to make a mundane sheep seem special...
Master Piece#009.dst: 你得在某個地方說點謊，才能讓一頭平凡的羊顯得特別……

Master Piece#010.src: It has large horns- no, say it's just one.
Master Piece#010.dst: 牠有很大的角——不，就說只有一隻角。

Master Piece#011.src: Clean white wool, instead of black...

Master Piece#012.src: A pure white sheep with one horn...?
Master Piece#012.dst: 一頭純白、只有一隻角的羊……？

Master Piece#013.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully that's good enough for him.
Master Piece#013.dst: 該回去找 Caissop 了。希望這樣夠唬得過他。

Master Piece#014.src: Snowy white, a large horn... A Unicorn Sheep, you say?!
Master Piece#014.dst: 雪一般的白，一隻大角……你是說，獨角羊？！

Master Piece#015.src: ...OH, NO, NO. YES! MORE COLOUR, MORE PAINT! I'M OUT OF RED!
Master Piece#015.dst: ……喔，不、不對。對了！再多點顏色，再多點顏料！我的紅色用完了！

Master Piece#016.src: The creatures guarding these animals seem more legendary to you.
Master Piece#016.dst: 在你看來，守著這些動物的生物還比較有傳說的樣子。

Master Piece#017.src: No way you can describe a pig fantastically. You'll have to outright make something up...
Master Piece#017.dst: 豬這種東西怎麼樣都描述不出奇幻感。你只能整個掰一個出來……

Master Piece#018.src: Pink is fine, it's a rare color...
Master Piece#018.dst: 粉紅色可以，那是稀有的顏色……

Master Piece#019.src: ...what if you say it has wings?

Master Piece#020.src: Will he believe a flying pig?

Master Piece#021.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully he won't be able to tell something's amiss.
Master Piece#021.dst: 該回去找 Caissop 了。希望他看不出哪裡不對勁。

Master Piece#022.src: Talk to Caissop the artist, in his tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#022.dst: 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的帳篷，與藝術家 Caissop 對話

Master Piece#024.src: Oh sorry, I didn't notice you. Did you want an autograph?
Master Piece#024.dst: 哦，抱歉，我沒注意到你。你是來要簽名的嗎？
Master Piece#024.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#025.src: Wait, no? Don't you know who I am?! It seems like you have no taste in art... I am Caissop, the legendary artist!
Master Piece#025.dst: 等等，不是？你不知道我是誰？！看來你對藝術毫無品味……我是 Caissop，傳奇的藝術家！
Master Piece#025.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#026.src: Though, since you are not a fan... Perhaps you can help me? I am looking for a new assistant.
Master Piece#026.dst: 不過，既然你不是我的粉絲……那也許你可以幫我？我正在找新的助手。
Master Piece#026.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#027.src: Excellent... I need your help to find three legendary creatures that are hiding in caves around the swamp.
Master Piece#027.dst: 太好了……我需要你幫我找到三隻藏在沼澤各處洞窟裡的傳奇生物。
Master Piece#027.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#028.src: I actually know their location, but unfortunately, I am...blind.
Master Piece#028.dst: 牠們在哪我其實知道，可惜的是，我……眼睛看不見。
Master Piece#028.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#029.src: For me to do my work I need to imagine them! That's where you come in. I need you to find them and describe them to me!
Master Piece#029.dst: 要創作，我必須先在腦中想像出牠們！這就是你派上用場的地方了。我要你去找到牠們，然後描述給我聽！
Master Piece#029.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#030.src: Would you turn your back on a blind man?! I need you to give me an accurate description of them! Once you have found one, come back and describe it to me exactly!
Master Piece#030.dst: 你要對一個瞎子見死不救嗎？！我需要你給我準確的描述！找到一隻就回來，一五一十地描述給我聽！
Master Piece#030.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#031.src: The first cave is up a hill with tall, thin-leafed flowers. They smell pink to me, and of this I am certain.
Master Piece#031.dst: 第一個洞窟在一座小丘上，那裡有細葉的高花。對我來說它們聞起來是粉紅色的，這點我很確定。
Master Piece#031.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#032.src: Search for the first mythical creature in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#032.dst: 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的洞窟中尋找第一隻神話生物

Master Piece#033.src: Report back with the description of the brown, large-snouted creature to Caissop
Master Piece#033.dst: 回去向 Caissop 描述那隻棕色的大鼻子生物

Master Piece#034.src: Quick! Describe it to me! Go on!
Master Piece#034.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#035.src: Brown...big-nosed... A Villager Cow, you say!?
Master Piece#035.dst: 棕色……大鼻子……你說那是一頭村民牛？！
Master Piece#035.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#037.src: ...MH, NO, A LITTLE MORE RED!..... YES!
Master Piece#037.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#038.src: Haha! This is WONDERFUL! I'm not going to show it to you before it is finished!
Master Piece#038.dst: 哈哈！這太精采了！沒完成之前我是不會給你看的！
Master Piece#038.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#039.src: Savor the ideas! So now, I need you to go to the second cave...
Master Piece#039.dst: 好好品味這些點子吧！那麼現在，我要你去第二個洞窟……
Master Piece#039.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#040.src: It is down a road, with short, round-cupped flowers. Those ones smell orange to me!
Master Piece#040.dst: 它在一條路的盡頭，那裡有矮矮的、杯狀的圓花。那些對我來說聞起來是橘色的！
Master Piece#040.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#041.src: Hurry! I'll finish this animal while you are gone. OH, YES. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#041.dst: 快去！你走的時候我會把這隻動物畫完。喔，太好了。MUY MACHO。
Master Piece#041.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#042.src: Search for the second mythical beast in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#042.dst: 在 [-{~1},-{~2}] 的洞窟中尋找第二隻神話野獸

Master Piece#043.src: Report back with the description of the white, big-horned creature to Caissop
Master Piece#043.dst: 回去向 Caissop 描述那隻白色的大角生物

Master Piece#044.src: You're here! Quick! Don't look at me, describe it!
Master Piece#044.dst: 你來了！快！別看我，快描述！
Master Piece#044.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#045.src: Snow white, a large horn... A Unicorn Sheep, you say?!
Master Piece#045.dst: 雪白、一根大角……你說那是一頭獨角綿羊？！
Master Piece#045.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#046.src: ...OH YES, THE WOOL IS REAL... MORE SWIPING... OH YES, BIEN!
Master Piece#046.dst: ……喔太好了，這羊毛是真的……再刷幾筆……喔，BIEN！
Master Piece#046.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#047.src: ... THIS IS UNIQUE, REMARKABLE, YES. SUPERNATURAL!
Master Piece#047.dst: ……這太獨特了，太出色了，沒錯。超凡脫俗！
Master Piece#047.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#048.src: The last creature! Red-smelling flowers, prickly thorns, hurry, mucho inspired!
Master Piece#048.dst: 最後一隻！聞起來是紅色的花，帶尖刺的，快去，mucho inspired！
Master Piece#048.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#050.src: I'LL JUST USE MY BLOOD! OH! YES! ...INSPIRED! REMARKABLE! Huh? Why are you still here? Go! I need that last description!
Master Piece#050.dst: 那我就用我的血！喔！太好了！……靈感來了！太出色了！咦？你怎麼還在這？快去！我要最後那個描述！
Master Piece#050.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#051.src: Search for the third and last mythical animal in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#051.dst: 在 [-{~1},-{~2}] 的洞窟中尋找第三隻、也是最後一隻神話動物

Master Piece#052.src: Report back with the description of the pink, flying creature to Caissop
Master Piece#052.dst: 回去向 Caissop 描述那隻粉紅色的飛行生物

Master Piece#053.src: You're finally back! I just finished the last one. Go! Describe it!
Master Piece#053.dst: 你總算回來了！我剛把最後一隻畫完。說！描述！
Master Piece#053.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#055.dst: 那是……一頭天馬豬！多棒的名字！
Master Piece#055.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#056.src: ...OH YES, WINGS! EYES FROM HEAVEN! OH, YES.
Master Piece#056.dst: ……喔對，翅膀！來自天堂的眼睛！喔，太好了。
Master Piece#056.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#057.src: Och, Perfect. The final touch and, done! You were so inspiring that I made two! One for you, and one for me!
Master Piece#057.dst: 噢，完美。最後一筆，然後，完成！你給了我太多靈感，我一口氣畫了兩幅！一幅給你，一幅給我！
Master Piece#057.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#058.src: You might want to hold onto that, big-town upper class Villagers pay through the roof for Caissop's work!
Master Piece#058.dst: 這個你最好收好，大城市裡那些上流村民為了 Caissop 的作品可是願意砸大錢的！
Master Piece#058.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#059.src: Thank you for your assistance, what a rush! Good luck on your Gavel adventure!
Master Piece#059.dst: 謝謝你的幫忙，真是暢快！祝你在 Gavel 的冒險順利！
Master Piece#059.speaker: Caissop
